subject: science
concept: Understanding natural selection as the mechanism driving evolution
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Natural Selection and Adaptation) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student runs a physical simulation where a trait variation affects survival across simulated generations
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a population change over time to the selective pressure that likely caused it
exercise.abstract: Student explains, using the four key principles (variation, inheritance, selection, time), how natural selection leads to evolution

misconception_flags: believes an individual organism changes/adapts within its own lifetime rather than the population changing across generations

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
